name: Justiciar armour (set)
description: Converts a portion of your armour's defensive stats directly into extra damage reduction, on top of the normal defence formula.

name: Obsidian armour (set) + obsidian weapon
description: +20% melee accuracy and +10% melee damage when worn together with an obsidian weapon (e.g. Toktz-xil-ak, tzhaar-ket-om).

name: Void knight equipment (set)
description: +10% accuracy and damage in the matching combat style (melee/ranged/magic) when the full set + correct helm is worn; elite void adds further ranged/magic damage.

name: Inquisitor's armour (set)
description: Boosts crush accuracy/damage per piece worn, stacking with the Inquisitor's mace's own passive for a larger combined bonus at full set.

name: Dharok's armour (set)
description: Damage increases the lower your current hitpoints are, up to nearly 3x max hit at 1 HP remaining, when the full set is worn.

name: Verac's armour (set)
description: Attacks have a chance to ignore the target's Defence and Prayer protection entirely when the full set is worn.

name: Karil's armour (set)
description: Chance to lower the target's Agility level on a successful hit when the full set is worn with a crossbow.

name: Guthan's armour (set)
description: Full set + Guthan's warspear: successful melee attacks have a 25% chance to heal the wielder HP equal to the damage dealt - a pure gamble mechanic not shown anywhere on the stats screen.

name: Torag's armour (set)
description: Full set + Torag's hammers: successful melee hits have a 25% chance to reduce the target's run energy by 20%. Only functions against players in PvP/Wilderness - no effect on NPCs, and not shown on the stats screen.

name: Ahrim's armour (set)
description: Full set + Ahrim's staff: successful magic attacks have a 25% chance to lower the target's Strength level by 5 (does not trigger on a splash) - a proc invisible in the interface.

name: Serpentine helm
description: Grants full immunity to poison and venom while charged (does not cure existing poison). Also gives melee/ranged/magic hits on NPCs an unlisted chance to envenom them: 16.7% with a non-poisoned weapon, 50% with a poisoned weapon, 100% with the toxic blowpipe or trident of the swamp.

name: Slayer helmet / Slayer helmet (i)
description: On an assigned Slayer task, grants a hidden +16.67% Attack and Strength boost (melee); the imbued version also grants +15% Ranged and Magic accuracy/damage on task. Also carries hidden component effects: blocks Nex's virus infection, counts as warm clothing for Wintertodt, negates Dust/Smoke devil stat drain, and deafens Banshee screams.

name: Ava's assembler
description: Beyond its displayed +4 Ranged attack / +2 Ranged Strength, it silently returns fired ammunition to the quiver at an 80% recovery rate - an invisible ammo-conservation mechanic not shown on the stats interface.

name: Spectral spirit shield
description: Passively halves the effect of most enemy prayer-draining attacks outside of PvP (e.g. Cerberus's souls, K'ril Tsutsaroth's smash, Nex, Barrows brothers), a reduction not listed on the stats interface.

name: Fire cape
description: Grants the hidden 'fiery' attribute, causing extra PvP damage taken from Pearl bolts (e)/Pearl dragon bolts (e), and separately counts as warm clothing for Wintertodt. It does not grant fire or lava immunity, despite popular belief.

name: Crystal armour (set)
description: Each piece silently boosts crystal bow/Bow of Faerdhinen damage and accuracy (helm 2.5%/5%, legs 5%/10%, body 7.5%/15%; +15%/+30% at full set) - a bonus applied invisibly, not reflected in the bow's own stats.

name: Elite void knight equipment (top & robe)
description: Beyond the shared Void Knight set-effect bonuses, adds a further hidden +2.5% Ranged damage and +5% Magic damage on top of the base void set bonuses - only the +3 prayer per piece is shown on the stats screen.

name: Blood moon armour (set)
description: Full set + dual macuahuitl: successful hits have a 33% chance to attack one tick early (the 'Bloodrager' set effect), not shown on the stats screen.

name: Eclipse moon armour (set)
description: Full set + Eclipse atlatl: successful hits have a 20% chance to inflict a stacking burn (10 damage over 40 ticks, up to 5 stacks), not shown on the stats screen.

name: Virtus robes (set)
description: The displayed equipment stat shows a flat 2% magic damage bonus per piece (6% total), but each piece silently grants 5% instead (15% total) specifically when casting Ancient Magicks combat spells - the higher bonus isn't shown on the gear screen.
